messages:
aaron: PTAL at https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 — small runtime change that tweaks the batching window heuristic and the KV cache eviction TTL. goal: reduce tail latency on short-burst workloads without hurting steady-state throughput. would like this merged before the 6pm UTC release cut (about 4h).

Summary in PR: adjust batch.max_window_ms from 25 -> 15 for short bursts, add batch_fill_ratio metric, and change kv.default_ttl_ms logic to prefer quick eviction on low-hit workloads. perf runs attached.

Config snippet:
```yaml
batch:
  max_window_ms: 15
kv:
  default_ttl_ms: 5000
```

maria: reading now, quick q — does the smaller batch window hurt long-sequence throughput or increase GPU kernel churn?

aaron: shouldn't for long sequences — this only tightens the time cap for small concurrent requests. long seqs still get continuous batching. my perf runs show unchanged p50/p90 for seq>1024. numbers in the PR description.

sasha: left one nit about variable naming. also we need a KV owner sign-off for the eviction policy change — cc @kevin @olivia :eyes:

kevin: on it, reviewing in ~30m. FYI CI shows a flaky failure on gpu-batcher-smoke unrelated to this change earlier — I'll trigger a rerun.

ci-bot: CI: gpu-batcher-smoke failed on runner nvidia-rt-2 (test: batcher_integration.smoke). Rerun requested by kevin. Queued job #5421.

olivia: I can take the KV piece — one quick question: any reason we can't increase default_ttl to 10s to reduce churn? current PR uses 5s.

aaron: left a comment in the PR explaining TTL=5s choice. tradeoff: 10s reduces eviction churn but increases mem pressure on bursty traffic (we saw 20% higher peak mem in load test). prefer default 5s for now, we can expose as config for customers.

kevin: Approved with one followup: add a short note to CHANGELOG about the batch window toggle and the metric addition. :thumbsup:

sasha: Approved from perf side. merge window is open for 2h (we cut at 6pm UTC). please squash and merge when CI goes green. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-preview: staging build started for runtime@pr-4123, build id staging-7853, ETA ~12m.

aaron: thanks all — will squash, address the nit, and merge when CI passes. ping me if you want a revert-ready rollback policy added. :pray:

kevin: noted, will keep an eye on post-merge metrics.

last action: CI rerun completed green, merge performed at ~1923456840.
